title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2023
part_text: 60. Notes the adoption by the EIB Board of Directors of the EIB Global Strategic Roadmap and its commitment to respect and promote human rights and the rule of law in the projects it supports; stresses the urgent need for systematic ex ante human rights impact assessments, greater transparency, and full public accountability in all EIB operations outside the EU;
